description: The semantic stage decides the `ol-repcount-outside-repeat` row too (spec/tooling.md:195), and by the same reasoning the runtime uses: `repcount` reports the turn of the `repeat` that LEXICALLY encloses it, so a procedure body is never inside its caller's `repeat` (spec/execution-model.md:673-678), a `repcount` with no `repeat` anywhere has nothing to report, and a `forever` is not an enclosing loop — it runs a block without a turn number, and spec/commands.md:804 ties `repcount` to "the innermost `repeat`" (measured: `forever [ print repcount ]` raises at run time too). All three shapes are asserted in one program because the checker reports EVERY occurrence, which the executing twins cannot do — measured, `execute()` on this exact program reports only the line-2 read and stops, so `scoping/repcount-does-not-cross-the-procedure-boundary` and `execution/repcount-outside-repeat` each need a program of their own. Measured before this slice: check() reported NOTHING here; the whole row was unimplemented at Layer 2, so a learner was told about this only by running.
